name: vibetiles
description: Style your website from a chat, through Vibetiles, on your real page in a Chrome window you can watch.
long_description: Your site runs Vibetiles, the design panel on the live page. This extension opens it for the AI: it reads every setting and what it means, changes settings by name as one step you can undo, checks that the page still reads well, and looks at the page. It publishes only when you ask. The first time, a Chrome window opens on your page: log in to your site there, open the page again, and ask again. Needs Google Chrome.

site_url.title: Your site's address
site_url.description: A page on your site, for example a blog post. The design is changed there.

tools.name: describe
tools.description: Every setting with what it means, its values and its current value.

tools.name: set_settings
tools.description: Change settings by name, as one step you can undo.

tools.name: preview
tools.description: Show a change on the page without keeping it.

tools.name: end_preview
tools.description: Leave a preview and show the kept style again.

tools.name: check
tools.description: The reading check in numbers: contrast, text size, line length, line spacing.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: The current style in one plain paragraph.

tools.name: get_style
tools.description: The whole style as a record, with a link that carries it.

tools.name: load_style
tools.description: Load a whole style as one step you can undo.

tools.name: open_panel
tools.description: Open the design panel on the page.

tools.name: publish
tools.description: Only when you ask: the look becomes a style on your site.

tools.name: look
tools.description: See the page, or one part of it.
